"Create a mobile-first Android fantasy RPG called AETHERIA.

Build a dark, beautiful fantasy clicker RPG with high-quality visuals, smooth animations and satisfying combat. The game should feel like a real RPG, not a basic clicker.

CORE GAMEPLAY

- The player controls one hero and fights monsters by manually tapping the attack button.
- Every basic attack must be triggered by the player. NO auto-attacks, NO auto-combat and NO autoplay.
- Show the hero and enemy visibly fighting with attack animations, impact effects, floating damage numbers and health bars.
- Add separate buttons for special skills with impressive visual effects.
- Defeating enemies grants XP, Gold and occasional equipment or crafting materials.
- Include increasingly difficult enemies, elite monsters and powerful bosses.

CHARACTER CREATION

- Choose Warrior, Mage or Assassin.
- Choose male or female character appearance.
- Choose Angels or Demons as a permanent faction.
- Allow the player to enter a unique character name.
- Show the selected character in the game world.

PROGRESSION

- Character levels, XP and upgradeable attributes.
- Unlock and improve class-specific skills.
- Equipment with different rarities and powerful bonuses.
- Nine equipment slots.
- Monster drops, crafting and equipment fusion.
- Add a long-term progression system with increasingly challenging areas and bosses.

WORLD
Create a dark fantasy world with several visually distinct regions:
Greendale, Ironcrag, Venomwood, Mistgrave, Frostpeak, Sunscorch Desert, Ashen Dominion and Tower of Eternity.

Each region should have unique monsters, backgrounds, elite enemies and bosses. Add a progression map so players unlock new regions as they advance.

EQUIPMENT AND LOOT
Include weapons, armor, accessories, wings and cosmetic items.
Use rarity tiers: Common, Grey, Green, Blue, Purple, Legendary, Mythic and Divine.
Add a fusion system: combine four identical items to upgrade them. Never randomly destroy items during fusion.
Legendary, Mythic and Divine equipment should be difficult to obtain.

CURRENCIES AND SHOP

- Gold for normal gameplay purchases and upgrades.
- Gems as a premium currency that can also be earned through gameplay.
- Cosmetic shop with costumes, hairstyles, wings, mounts and weapon effects.
- Prepare the architecture for Google Play Billing.
- Never simulate successful real-money purchases. Use clearly labeled test purchases until actual billing is integrated.
- No mandatory purchases and no pay-to-win requirement.

ONLINE SYSTEM
This is an online single-player game, NOT a multiplayer game.

- Account registration and login.
- Secure cloud saving for characters, levels, equipment, currencies and progression.
- Players can access their own save from another device.
- No PvP, guilds, trading or shared combat.
- Never pretend that local storage is a real online account or cloud save. If backend services are unavailable, clearly identify the missing integration.

DESIGN AND MOBILE UI

- Portrait orientation, designed for Android phones.
- Beautiful dark fantasy atmosphere with detailed environments and character models.
- Clear, polished buttons and readable text.
- Combat screen should focus on the hero and monster.
- Add inventory, equipment, character stats, skills, quests, world map and shop screens.
- Smooth transitions and responsive touch controls.

IMPORTANT DEVELOPMENT RULES
Build a working and playable first version, not just mockup screens.
Prioritize stable gameplay, character creation, one complete region, several monsters, one boss, equipment drops, leveling and saving.
Use clean, modular architecture so more regions, enemies, items and features can be added later.
Do not attempt to build every future feature at once. First create a polished, playable foundation and test it on an Android-sized screen.

All in-game interface text should be in English.
The game must be designed exclusively for mobile devices, not PC.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a polished, playable mobile-first dark fantasy RPG called AETHERIA, focused on character creation, manual combat, Greendale, drops, leveling, and local saves.

## Requirements
- Basic attacks are always manually triggered; no auto-combat or autoplay.
- Include character creation (Warrior/Mage/Assassin, male/female appearance, Angels/Demons faction, unique name), combat animations, skills, monsters/bosses, progression, equipment, and English mobile UI.
- Clearly distinguish local saving from real online accounts/cloud saving; do not simulate real-money purchases.
- Keep the architecture extensible and test at an Android-sized viewport.

## Decisions
- Implement as a responsive browser game with localStorage saves; backend/cloud accounts and Google Play Billing are not integrated.
- Greendale is the first playable region; other named regions are progressive map entries.

### Completed
- Added `index.html` with battle UI, navigation, combatant artwork, secondary screens, and modal/toast containers.
- Added `style.css` with dark fantasy styling, responsive navigation/layout, combat effects, and secondary-screen components.

- Updated `showScreen()` to close the mobile sidebar via `.sidebar` instead of the nonexistent `#sidebar`.

- Validate gameplay, persistence, and mobile layout at an Android-sized viewport.

### Blocked
- Real online accounts/cloud saves and Google Play Billing require external backend/platform integrations not present in the project.

## Next Move
1. Remove the orphaned code at `game.js` line 42 and inspect the remainder of the file for unfinished functions or malformed edits.
2. Finish equipment, fusion, character creation, event handlers, and startup/resume flow.
3. Run syntax checks and test combat, progression, saves, and mobile layout.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: In-progress game logic; recent edits have not been syntax-checked or browser-tested.
- `index.html`: Main game markup and screen/modal containers.
- `style.css`: Game visuals and responsive mobile layouts.

- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- `baseState()` initializes `questClaimed`.
- Cloud saving and real-money purchases are explicitly not integrated; the UI identifies saves as local and cosmetics use only earned in-game currency.

- Build a polished, playable mobile-first dark fantasy RPG called AETHERIA, centered on character creation, manual combat, Greendale, drops, leveling, and local saves.

## Requirements
- Basic attacks are manually triggered; no auto-combat or autoplay.
- Include Warrior/Mage/Assassin, male/female appearance, Angels/Demons faction, unique hero name, combat animations, skills, monsters/bosses, progression, equipment, and an English mobile UI.
- Distinguish local saving from real online accounts/cloud saving; do not simulate real-money purchases.
- Keep the architecture extensible and validate at an Android-sized viewport.

## Decisions
- Implement as a responsive browser game using localStorage; backend/cloud accounts and Google Play Billing are not integrated.
- Greendale is the first playable region; other named regions are progressive map entries.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added `index.html` battle UI, navigation, combatant artwork, secondary screens, and modal/toast containers; added `style.css` responsive dark fantasy styling.
- Implemented core `game.js` state, local save/load, combat, retaliation, rewards, XP/leveling, drops, and secondary pages.
- Added equipment, item details/equipping, four-identical-item fusion, character creation/resume modal logic, event binding, startup/load validation, and an action-pending guard against repeated combat inputs.
- `node --check game.js` passed after the recent edits.

### Active
- Finish and verify startup/resume wiring and exercise character creation, combat, progression, inventory/fusion, and save/load.
- Test browser runtime behavior and Android-sized layout; fix discovered issues.

### Blocked
- Real online accounts/cloud saves and Google Play Billing require external backend/platform integrations not present in the project.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the end of `game.js` and ensure `boot()` is invoked; verify event handlers, especially modal close, resume, and new-hero flows.
2. Run the game in a browser and test creation, manual combat, rewards/progression, equipment/fusion, and persistence.
3. Validate the Android-sized viewport and address runtime or UI issues.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game logic and recently added creation, equipment, fusion, and startup functions.
- `index.html`: Battle UI, navigation, screens, and modal containers.
- `style.css`: Game visuals and mobile/responsive layouts.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked.
- `boot()` and related startup logic were added, but the latest recorded file tail ends at `openWelcome()` and does not show a call to `boot()`.
- `baseState()` initializes `questClaimed`; cloud saving and real-money purchases are explicitly not integrated.
